title: Synthesis, structure and slow magnetic relaxation of a linear Ho4 cluster

synthesis.procedure: H3L (0.03 mmol) and Ho(tmhd)3·2H2O (0.03 mmol) were successively added to a mixture of CH2Cl2 (10 mL) and CH3OH (15 mL). The mixture was stirred for 4.0 h at room temperature, then concentrated slowly by evaporation at 4 °C. After about 7 days, block-shaped red crystals of 1 were obtained.
synthesis.temperature: stirred at room temperature; crystallization at 4 °C
synthesis.time: stirred 4.0 h; crystals after about 7 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution stirring followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: resulting solution concentrated slowly by evaporation at 4 °C; block-shaped red crystals obtained after about 7 days

properties.summary: Linear Ho4 cluster 1 shows slow magnetic relaxation under zero dc field with weak frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac signals below 10 K but no χ″ peaks because of fast QTM. Under 3000 Oe the QTM is largely suppressed, χ″ peaks appear (111–2311 Hz), and Arrhenius fitting gives ΔE/kB = 13.8 K and τ0 = 2.8 × 10−6 s. DC data are consistent with thermal depopulation of Ho(III) Stark sublevels and/or weak antiferromagnetic Ho···Ho interactions.
